summary.text: Jonathan Warrey is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 22 (home city listed as Casselton), serving since 2022 per the legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for Warrey lists an occupation of Technology Executive, Marco.
It lists education as BS, Marketing, UND.
It also lists Casselton Park Board, Emerging Prairie Treasurer and Casselton Economic Development Committee.
Family is listed as: Married (Amy); 2 children.
For the 2025 regular session, the page lists Warrey's standing committee assignments as Industry, Business and Labor (chairman) and Political Subdivisions.
